name: sota-convergence-audit
description: Reusable Google Antigravity /run-workflow programmatic audit pipeline for sealed manifest verification, ast-grep structural ban scans, host ecosystem hygiene, unit tests, and strict Zensical portal builds.

check_host_hygiene.description: Run the read-only zero-secret local ecosystem hygiene auditor (scripts/audit_ecosystem_hygiene.py --json --strict).

run_tests.description: Execute the full repository stdlib unittest suite (python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v).

strict_portal.description: Build the static MADR 4.0.0 ADR documentation portal with strict warning checks (zensical build --strict).
